name: stone fireplace seen from above-front: flat stone top of the chimney breast visible, deep wooden mantel shelf top, burning fire
label: sky-island/si-hearth-f1

answer.evidence: The main body (the stone chimney breast) extends to the top edge of the sprite as a flat vertical brick wall with no visible top surface (0px). While the wooden mantel shelf shows a top surface (rows 12-15), the main stone body above it is drawn in flat front elevation.

The chimney breast above the mantel shelf (rows 0-11) is drawn in pure front elevation with no visible top surface at all (0 rows). While the wooden mantel shelf shows a 4-row top surface, the main volume of the fireplace structure rises above it as a completely flat front-facing brick wall.

The main stone body of the fireplace and chimney breast is drawn in flat front elevation with vertical mortar lines extending off the top border (rows 0-11) with no top surface visible. While the mantel shelf has a 4-pixel top surface (rows 12-15), the main body itself lacks any top surface and the hearth opening is a flat black rectangle.

answer.main_body: stone fireplace with chimney breast and wooden mantel shelf
answer.evidence: The wooden mantel shelf clearly shows a 4-pixel deep horizontal top surface (rows 12-15) viewed from above with objects resting on it, above a 2-pixel front face (rows 16-17).
